# DevHub Toolkit

> 44 fast, keyboard-first developer utilities — formatters, encoders, generators, AI helpers, and references — in one clean interface.

DevHub Toolkit is a browser-based developer productivity platform. All non-AI tools run client-side with no tracking. AI tools call Google Gemini via a server endpoint.

## Pages

- [Home](https://huggable-heart-helper-93.lovable.app/): Browse and search all tools.
- [Favorites](https://huggable-heart-helper-93.lovable.app/favorites): Your saved tools.
